synopsis: ASME V&V 10 is identified as an American Society of Mechanical Engineers verification-and-validation standard for structural models; its 2019 edition, Verification and Validation in Computational Solid Mechanics, covers structures and solids [f14616, f14618]. Chapter 10 lists it among standards and guides spanning various domains [f8154]. Chapter 12 places V&V 10 (2019) within the wider ASME VVUQ portfolio, which uses verification, validation and uncertainty quantification to assess computational-model credibility relative to a context of use [f9748]. However, both Chapter 10 and the glossary explicitly say the research did not verify V&V 10, so its inclusion should not be mistaken for a verified assessment of the standard [f7632, f14623].

relations.note: Both explicitly state that V&V 10 and V&V 20 were not verified.
Adds V&V 10's edition, formal title and solids scope to the structural-model definition.
Specifies the ASME standards' domains within Chapter 10's cross-domain list.
Adds the portfolio's context-of-use credibility methodology to the standards listing.
Qualifies the listing: naming V&V 10 did not mean verifying it.
Limits the research assurance behind Chapter 12's characterization: V&V 10 was not verified.
